2607.24192.title: LLM-based Source Code Compression via Thresholded Symbol Ranking
2607.24192.paper_summary: We study the problem of lossless compression of source code, motivated by the storage demands of large-scale software archives, such as Software Heritage (https://www.softwareheritage.org/). General-purpose compressors (e.g., zstd, bzip2) offer a good trade-off between compression ratio and speed, but fail to exploit all special regularities inherent in source code. Recent approaches leverage Large Language Models (LLMs) within Shannon's symbol-ranking framework, relying on a scheme in which the predicted rank can grow arbitrarily. While effective at reducing space, this setting incurs significant throughput degradation, and leaves open the question whether it is necessary to explicitly encode all ranks. In this work, we introduce LLM-based compressors deploying two novel symbol-ranking variants that bound predictions to the top-$T$ ranks ($T=1$ or $63$), with out-of-threshold symbols stored as exceptions and compressed jointly with the rank stream via general-purpose compressors. We conduct the first large-scale evaluation of LLM-based source code compression across 30 LLMs, including general-domain, code-specialized, and quantized models. Our $T$-bounded approach outperforms prior LLM-based compressors both in compression ratio (up to 37% relative improvement) and compression throughput (40% faster). Compared to general-purpose compressors (e.g., zstd, bzip2), we obtain up to 82% relative compression gain but at a lower speed, thus offering a new trade-off point in the compression-speed spectrum. We also show that these gains are stronger on source code than on natural language, suggesting an interesting indication, namely that source code exposes regularities captured by LLMs but missed by general-purpose exact-match-based compressors. We conclude by commenting on open problems that offer theoretical and practical avenues of research.
2607.24192.paper_summary_zh: 我們研究無損壓縮源代碼的問題，這是受到大型軟體檔案庫（例如 Software Heritage (https://www.softwareheritage.org/)）的儲存需求所驅動。通用壓縮器（例如 zstd、bzip2）在壓縮比和速度之間提供了良好的折衷，但未能充分利用源代碼中固有的所有特殊規律。最近的方法在香農的符號排名框架內利用大型語言模型（LLMs），依賴於一種預測排名可以任意增長的方案。雖然在減少空間方面有效，但這種設置會造成顯著的吞吐量下降，並且留下了一個問題，即是否有必要明確編碼所有排名。在這項工作中，我們介紹了基於 LLM 的壓縮器，部署了兩種新型符號排名變體，將預測限制在前 $T$ 名排名（$T=1$ 或 $63$），超出閾值的符號作為例外存儲，並與排名流一起通過通用壓縮器進行壓縮。我們對 30 種 LLM 進行了首次大規模的基於 LLM 的源代碼壓縮評估，包括通用領域、專門代碼和量化模型。我們的 $T$ 限制方法在壓縮比（最高可達 37% 的相對改善）和壓縮吞吐量（快 40%）方面均優於先前的基於 LLM 的壓縮器。與通用壓縮器（例如 zstd、bzip2）相比，我們獲得了高達 82% 的相對壓縮增益，但速度較慢，因此在壓縮速度光譜中提供了一個新的折衷點。我們還顯示這些增益在源代碼上比在自然語言上更強，這表明一個有趣的指示，即源代碼揭示了 LLM 捕捉到的規律，而通用的精確匹配基礎壓縮器卻未能捕捉到。我們最後對開放問題進行了評論，這些問題提供了理論和實踐的研究途徑。
2607.24192.author: Angelo Nardone et.al.
